title: On Sticking the notice to the gate
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：stick　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stick 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the coach ① stuck the notice to the gate without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② sticks the notice to the gate at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ stick the notice to the gate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ stuck the notice to the gate before — a line in the record for April 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sticking the notice to the gate without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ stick to the old method for years at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Stick to the old method for years at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ sticks to the old method for years without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ stuck the notice to the gate again when nobody else would.

⑩ To stick the notice to the gate, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody sticks the notice to the gate at once again and somebody must stick the notice to the gate without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 粘住（一般过去式 stuck the notice to the gate：1960 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 粘住（一般现在 sticks the notice to the gate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 粘住（不定式 to stick the notice to the gate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 粘住（过去完成时 had stuck the notice to the gate：1954 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 粘住（动名词 sticking the notice to the gate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 坚持（stick to the old method for years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去坚持多年坚持那套老办法）
G. v. 坚持（stick to the old method for years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 粘住（后段两处：新来的队员照例 sticks to the old method for years，而母亲又一次 stuck the notice to the gate）

stick 意为“粘住”，自那以后教练二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sticks。
stick 意为“粘住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯粘住把告示贴在那道门上”，此处为不定式 to stick the notice to the gate。
stick 意为“粘住”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人粘住过，故用过去完成时 had stuck。

stick 意为“坚持”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去坚持多年坚持那套老办法”，should ever 之后用原形 stick to the old method for years。

stick 意为“粘住”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例坚持多年坚持那套老办法，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sticks。

stick 意为“粘住”，结尾那句是母亲 1972 年的话：要粘住把告示贴在那道门上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stick 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the coach stuck the notice to the gate without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach sticks the notice to the gate at once whenever the field asks.
Sticking the notice to the gate without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever stick to the old method for years at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field sticks to the old method for years without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother stuck the notice to the gate again, and the field remembered that half.
